checks.detail: TaskSpec envelope payload_sha256 matches the committed T7 spec; allowed_files cover memory.py, operations.py, the memory test, and all evidence outputs; baseline and nine input evidence references hash-match live files.

LearningPacketRetentionMetadata is an immutable dataclass recording retention_class (RetentionClass member), last_referenced_at (date), and archive_eligible (bool); invalid packet_id, class, date, or bool values fail closed in __post_init__.

retention_cleanup_candidates computes age from last_referenced_at and returns only expired preview/staging packet ids sorted deterministically; preview and staging TTLs are separate positive integers and invalid TTLs raise ValueError.
Scientific entries are skipped regardless of age or archive_eligible, so scientific packets are never deleted by age; the operations report also returns preserved_scientific explicitly.

operations.retention_cleanup_report validates entries, delegates to memory, returns a deterministic schema-versioned report with priority='low' and real_data=False, and never reads or mutates real learning packets, data, or KBase content.
The only tracked source changes are memory.py, operations.py, and tests/test_control_plane_memory.py; no sealed TCB, policy, inventory, authority, store, run_research.py, or CLI file changed.
All six new retention tests failed before implementation (AttributeError on the missing surface), then passed 6/6 after implementation; focused memory suite is 100/100.

Authority pre-state is slice-completion ready: authorization CLAIMED, grant ACTIVE, T7 ticket ISSUED with zero trusted receipts, one open ticket, succeeded=(T1..T6), no failed/in-doubt, pending outbox 0, no P7 closure.

advisories.detail: run_research.py is outside T7 allowed_files; exposing the retention report through a CLI command is a non-blocking follow-up for a slice that owns run_research.py.
